title: GOLD case
description: One capability smoke-test case: single-turn (query + expected) or multi-turn (turns). The uid is a truncated SHA-256 over the canonical serialisation of the queries + non-empty expected values — order-sensitive across turns (see src/goldset/canonical.py); tools/check.py enforces that it is truthful.

id.description: Stable lineage id (e.g. '1-030', 'mt-001'). Survives edits; identifies the test's intent across versions.

uid.description: Content hash of query/queries + expectations. Changes on every semantic edit; results are keyed on it.

status.description: Lifecycle: ready | todo | done | not doing (lowercased on import).

group.description: Capability grouping (test_group); also the case's directory.

query.description: Single-turn only: the user prompt sent verbatim to the agent.

expected.description: Single-turn only: expectations, keyed without the 'expected_' prefix.

turns.description: Multi-turn only: scripted turns sharing one thread. Turn text must never depend on the agent's previous free text (determinism rule).

deltas.description: State-transition assertions vs the previous turn (turn >= 2 only). Fields are snapshot names: aoi_ids, dataset_id, context_layer, start_date, end_date, suggested_datasets, nudge_type, dashboard_id.

notes.description: Non-scored annotations. Never hashed: triage commentary must not mint a new version.
